searchText: Yes, very stable at 29K for transfer. It’s intriguing that limit can surge that much It is entirely deterministic. Any difference is an artifact of the contract being called. Best to talk to the authors of the contract to better understand the difference. Without a specific transaction we can only guess. Like this guess. Did the account have an existing balance? For a typical token contract if the receiving address didn't have any token balance and receives a balance a storage slot will transition from zero to a new value, which is charged 20k extra gas, and would requires 49k gas if that's the only impact. EIP-2200 covers all the cases on what to charge on specific storage cases. Thanks! I followed <@301186049323958275> advice to contact ACX token devs directly and they gave out the same answer - extra gas needed to initialize account with non-prior ACX token balance. My transfer tax went out of gas limit with MetaMask which is how I noticed this - but surprised that MetaMask did not implement EIP-2200? Metamask doesn't have an EVM, to my knowledge, so EIP-2200 wouldn't matter. Not sure why the gas estimate was low.
